results.title: Mediterranean: Dreams and Shores @ Mucem, Marseille
results.original_title: Méditerranée - Des rêves et des rives Mucem, Marseille
results.overview: Filmed at the Mucem in Marseille, this concert is a musical journey across the Mediterranean, bringing together the Berber singer Karimouche, Egyptian Natacha Atlas, Spanish Queralt Lahoz, Greek Dafné Kritharas, Franco-Algerian Nesrine, Moroccan Walid Ben Selim, Italian Agathe Di Piro, and Franco-Lebanese Hausmane.

results.title: Stratford Festival: A Midsummer Night’s Dream
results.original_title: Stratford Festival: A Midsummer Night’s Dream
results.overview: Strange things happen in the woods by night, with neither spirit nor mortal safe from the wiles of the trickster Puck. For mismatched lovers, romance runs delightfully amok, but true love triumphs at dawn.

results.title: Lady Champagne
results.overview: Champagne is one of San Francisco’s most notorious dancers. When she’s framed for her recent hubby’s death, she must outwit sinister businesswomen, incompetent detectives and sadistic prison guards. Starring a host of famous San Fran faces, Lady Champagne is the perfect queer counterpart to comedies like Airplane! and The Naked Gun.

results.title: Mosquito
results.overview: Summer in Vienna. Fifteen-year-old Matthias spends his time roaming the city with his best friend Leo until late at night. But life can sting a young person, too: an undefined gravity hangs over their shared time, triggered by loss.

results.title: The Leader
results.overview: In 1997, thirty-nine members of the American cult known as "Heaven's Gate" committed the largest mass suicide to ever take place on American soil. This is their story.

results.title: Ladies and Gentlemen, Brian Mulroney
results.overview: Via archival footage and a vintage yet unserious style, this is the hot-shot, right-wing, weird and wild story of Canada's Progressive Conservatives, told through the journey of 18th Prime Minister Brian Mulroney's career as a Tory hopeful to the day of his inauguration.

results.title: A Woman's Work
results.overview: After tragically losing her parents to the opioid epidemic, Jolene Harper, a young woman in her twenties living in rural Harlan County, Kentucky, takes a grueling job as a coal miner to single-handedly support and provide for her two younger sisters, Emmy and Lara. As she navigates the hyper-masculine and conservative mining environment, Jolene must also cope with the social pressures of her secret relationship with a local woman, Kylie Mitchell—a romance that ultimately forces her to choose between her deep familial responsibilities and her own desire for freedom.

results.title: Romeo + Juliet
results.overview: An original and danced adaptation of the Shakespeare classic.

results.title: Lena Situations - Celui où ils disent au revoir
results.original_title: Lena Situations - Celui où ils disent au revoir

results.title: Platypus
results.overview: Kimberly, a young schoolgirl in a small town, secretly dreams of the masked killer Platypus terrorizing the area. But nobody believes her, and the dreams are becoming more vivid, more violent, and ever closer to home.

results.title: Portraits
results.overview: Portraits is an intimate window into the life of Hung, a sketch artist in the middle of a bustling night market of Da Nang, Vietnam. With 2 charcoal pencils and masterful skills, Hung captures the essence of his subjects in minutes. In a world increasingly obsessed with the speed and precision of Artificial Intelligence, Hung offers a quiet, profound meditation on what it means to create.

results.title: Lavoreremo da grandi
results.overview: Three friends, Beppe, Umberto, and Gigi, await the arrival of young Toni to celebrate his newfound freedom. After an evening of heavy drinking at the village bar, the car they're about to drive home in hits something. Or rather, someone. Setting off a series of relentless bad decisions, the four flee and take refuge at Umberto's house. It will be a long night of plot twists, paradoxical and ridiculous situations, encounters and clashes between the protagonists and other improbable figures who populate that interminable day. Until the most unimaginable of solutions arrives at first light.

results.title: The French Teacher
results.overview: Graça, a lesbian woman living in Belo Horizonte with her French girlfriend Clara, gives private French lessons to support herself in a large Brazilian metropolis. As an independent Black woman from a lower-middle-class background, she finds herself confronted by the dark side of religious fanaticism when she is forced to live with an extremist evangelical family that gradually involves her in a mysterious plot that leads her to lose her mind.

results.title: The Mole
results.overview: Exhausted by the relentless pace of the construction site, Vali, a worker pushed to his limits, walks away from everything and begins digging a hole in the middle of a field. As he descends, reality shifts around him, carrying him through a series of spaces. Each place he passes through reflects his exhaustion, his fear, and his need for release.

results.title: Splash
results.overview: Paul is spending a hot summer day with his girlfriend at a public pool – until her charismatic ex-boyfriend appears, igniting a tense triangle of desire and jealousy that pushes Paul to choose between trust and control.

results.title: 1939-1940: A Strange Defeat
results.overview: In late summer 1939, the French learned that Adolf Hitler had attacked Poland. On September 3, France entered the war, twenty years after the carnage of World War I. Although France was considered the world’s leading military power, with a vast empire and a powerful ally in the United Kingdom, everyone was overcome with a sense of dread. Yet the fighting would not begin until May 1940 and would end with France’s defeat in June. How did the French people experience those few months—among the most decisive and darkest in the country’s history?

results.title: NAXOS
results.overview: On a research trip to Greece, Adam slips into a parallel life without marriage, children, or responsibility. With Nysa, a local, he drifts through enchanted freedom while haunted by the life he once took for granted.

results.title: Tchotchke
results.overview: After finding a strange, clown-shaped coin bank, a man is disturbed by visions that are only silenced by feeding it coins. As his fixation grows, he sacrifices everything to appease it.

results.title: Iyanu: The War of Twin Princes
results.original_title: Iyanu: The War of Twin Princes
results.overview: In the prosperous kingdom of Elu, King Oba Adedeji must choose an heir between his twin sons — one bold and decisive, the other thoughtful and restrained. When he refuses to decide, the kingdom is thrust into a conflict with lasting political and spiritual consequences, setting the stage for a war that will shape the future of Yorubaland.

results.title: Bára - Diary of a Rockstar
results.overview: Bára Basiková is an icon of Czech rock and other music genres. To what extent can her public, media-distorted image differ from the person she really is? The answer comes in the form of the latest long-term documentary study from Helena Třeštíková, whose empathy, coupled with admirable self-reflection and openness on the part of the protagonist, gives rise to a fascinating film portrait: over the course of fifty years we follow a woman who demonstrates remarkable strength as she faces the challenges of both her professional and private lives.​
